Team —

Quick handoff for Orbitwise Health (RID-4521). Deal signed yesterday; anticipated go-live window is late November. High-level context and asks below so CS can own the kickoff and implementation plan: 

Deal context:
- Product: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated burst capacity for production (50k tokens/day steady, spikes ~200k).
- Primary use case: in-app clinical summarization and search (PII scope: user clinical notes + limited PHI).
- Contract highlights: 12-month term, 99.9% uptime SLA, SOC2 attestation requirement, data residency in us-west.

External contacts:
- Lisa Park — Director of Data (lisa@orbitwise.com) — primary implementation contact
- Tom Nguyen — VP Eng (tom@orbitwise.com) — technical owner, firewall/infra 
- security_ops@orbitwise.com — security/SSO point

Open items for CS/Implementation:
1) Confirm kickoff date (target week of Oct 18) and assign primary CS owner.
2) Validate SSO + SAML metadata (Lisa/Tom to share).
3) Network/egress rules — they will whitelist Redwood IP ranges; Tom will provide network ACL window.
4) Finalize SOW deliverables & sign off (attached SOW v1; DocuSign link in HubSpot).
5) Acceptance criteria: test harness for summarization accuracy using 500 sample notes; latency target p95 < 450ms for 512-token requests.

Karthik, flagged a couple of technical items below — please see his note and add anything I missed.

Marissa/Chloe — recommend Chloe lead this one. Chloe, if you accept, please send an intro to Orbitwise with a proposed kickoff agenda and calendar invite.

Attachments: SOW-Orbitwise-v1.pdf, Orbitwise-implementation-checklist.xlsx

Thanks —
Sean

Adding a few technical notes from pre-sale: 
- Model & infra: We'll serve them on the "rw-clarity-13b" variant quantized to reduce mem footprint. Expected p95 latency baseline ~380ms at 512 tokens on dedicated nodes.
- Throughput/burst: Plan for a 2x burst window for first 6 weeks while they ramp; provisioned GPUs should be sufficient but we'll need alerting thresholds on token burn.
- Data handling: All request logs for the account will be retained for 30 days by default; Orbitwise requested 90-day retention for debugging — commercial/legal may need to sign off if changed.
- Compliance: They asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and encryption at rest keying details. I've attached the security FAQ we sent during diligence.

Action items for CS/SE:
- Capture SSO metadata and test assertion in staging.
- Coordinate with infra for a temporary increased quota for the ramp window.
- Confirm sample dataset transfer method (S3 pre-signed vs secure upload).

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
